svg.title: The webhook sender's GitLab pipeline
svg.desc: The webhook sender's GitLab pipeline: 11 nodes, 13 connections. 8 jobs in 3 stages, 2 of which start another pipeline, in the order they run: by needs, or stage after stage. A dashed arrow reaches a job that runs by hand or by its rules. Imported from GitLab CI/CD. Nodes: - Pipeline starts, terminal - chart/.gitlab-ci.yml (Child pipeline), external - parcelpoint/developer-docs (Downstream pipeline), external - CI and CD: test - lint (golangci-lint:v1.61), step - unit (2 matrix runs, golang:1.23), step - contract (golang:1.23, may fail), step - CI and CD: build - docker-image (docker:27), step - chart (when its rules match, golang:1.23), step - CI and CD: deploy - staging (when its rules match, deploys to staging, k8s:1.31.1), step - production (manual, deploys to production, k8s:1.31.1), step - docs (golang:1.23), step Connections: - chart to chart/.gitlab-ci.yml: triggers - docs to parcelpoint/developer-docs: triggers - Pipeline starts to lint - Pipeline starts to unit - unit to contract - lint to docker-image - unit to docker-image - lint to chart (dashed) - unit to chart (dashed) - contract to chart (dashed) - docker-image to staging (dashed) - staging to production (dashed) - production to docs

g.text: when its rules match, deploys to
